name: Shota Otoko no Ko Harem ~Ikenai Asobi ni Ochita Boku-tachi~
original_name: ショタ男の娘ハーレム　～イケナイ遊びに堕ちたボク達～
source:
Kou and Haru were best friends and lovers, always looking for another thrill. 
Things got complicated with Kou's sister Suzuka, a shotaphile who formed the third prong of a love triangle. 
Struggling with this Kou went to a rich man's house where he was allowed to mingle with the sexy boy-maids. 
Things didn't get any easier! What's in store for Kou and Haru, and Kou's tranny maids? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE132778.html]DLsite English[/url]]
